name: Virginia Beach Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
org: City of Virginia Beach, Youth Opportunities Office

offerings.summary: An eight-week paid summer job with the City of Virginia Beach or a local business, for Virginia Beach residents aged 16 and up.

loc.venue: City of Virginia Beach departments and partner businesses

age.raw: Participants aged between 16-21. (Must be 16 before June 4th)

residency.raw: Reside in the City of Virginia Beach (validated with a report card or college transcript or proof of residency)

sched.schedule_raw: June until August up to 7 days per week as needed; orientation June 15-18 (in person)

other: Commit to the entire 8-week program and the entire job readiness orientation
issues: The page refers to a minimum rate for employers but the wage figure is cut off; pay is not recorded as confirmed

offerings.summary: Virginia Beach residents aged sixteen to twenty-one are placed with an employer for eight weeks, with orientation in mid June and work from late June to early August.

age.raw: Participants aged between 16-21. (Must be 16 before June 4th)

residency.raw: Reside in the City of Virginia Beach (validated with a report card or college transcript or proof of residency).

other: two professional recommendations via the recommendation form
a recent report card or transcript sent to SYEP@VBgov.com

items.raw: employers pay the minimum rate provided by the programme

app.instructions: Submit the online application, complete the youth worker questionnaire, send two recommendations and a recent report card or transcript. Applications are reviewed every Monday and documents are due two weeks from the following Monday.

issues: The city publishes the window as Jan. 15 to March 12 with no year.
The page states employers pay a minimum rate but the rate itself did not resolve on retrieval and should be confirmed.
